question: Which observed transition classes account for the positive MM-JDWind minus DDPM ramp-CRPS gap?

method.transition_label: Determined from the observed truth at adjacent lead hours; 0=exact zero, I=(0,1), 1=exact one.
method.score: Empirical-distribution (V-statistic) CRPS of adjacent-hour increments, matching the repository metric semantics.
method.pooling: The outer-specific DDPM seed0 ensemble is paired with each of the three MM model seeds; DDPM observations are therefore repeated across MM-seed comparisons.
method.inferential_boundary: Descriptive mechanism attribution on the already-seen 150-day confirmation set. It is not a new confirmatory test and no conditional-subset superiority claim is made.

interpretation: On this seen data, the average ramp gap is overwhelmingly an interior-to-interior issue, so an atom-frozen continuous-flow adaptation is mechanistically coherent as the first pilot.
The result does not prove that the jump model is fully calibrated, that cross-state tail ramps are solved, or that the same decomposition holds in another wind dataset.
A state-duration/amplitude coupled model remains a conditional backup route, especially for external datasets where cross-state transitions explain a larger share of the gap.
